text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As summer training camp was drawing to a 
close—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that right? However... it is still 
incomplete.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"To complete this song, I need to run in 
many more races."

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: For instance... what about the Kikuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You're coming, aren't you? To the 
Kikuka-sho.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Because I made a promise to you...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Bravissimo...!! This just made things even 
more fun...!!

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
"Let's both train to our absolute limits. 
And then, let's blow everyone away."

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: Just how incredible our race is—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Once we're back at the academy, 
I'd like to post something about the 
Kikuka Sho. Could you prep it for me?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:

Trainer...!

text_block_list.text:
Summer ends, and autumn arrives. The 
autumn where the final stop of the Triple 
Crown awaits—
